goal: Implement the verified v1 system corrections in reviewable PR units, with parallel independent lanes and explicit contract decisions before architectural changes.
architecture: Reuse the native dependency graph, release-operation DAG, committed release roster and provider-observed in-memory recovery. Separate canonical distribution references, release ownership, version authority and required output/effect completion; native tools/CI retain build and authentication responsibility.
tech_stack: Safe Rust; MIT callisto-model and FSL engine/surface crates
Cargo, npm/pnpm, Python build/Maturin and Twine
System git, gh, curl and GitHub Actions

tasks.title: Settle scoped model and compatibility contracts before architectural code
steps: Read the decision matrix in V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md and obtain owner confirmation only for material choices, not routine implementation details. Existing-contract fixes do not wait for this task.

Implement canonical slash-qualified IDs for all new exact references; reject new bare/colon aliases and resolve existing records only through explicit ownership migration. Settle new default tags and legacy history rules. Keep directory locator distinct from native output identity; do not rename remote tags or infer a genuine source move.
Fix admitted Maturin dynamic/static authority cases and native mapping errors; choose draft/public-announcement timing under the agreed registry-before-announcement policy.

Fix required registry file-set authority before model changes: plan declarations versus build-time filenames/digests, binding to the immutable intent/envelope and per-file versus aggregate partial-operation proof. Do not append operations or change the sealed intent after build.

Choose public Python support and explicit behavior for distinct read/upload routes; authenticated/HTML-only indexes and mutable npm channels remain optional owner decisions. Document that native lifecycle hooks and their effects remain package-owner-controlled and outside Callisto's operation graph.

Record testable cases and exact versioned wire migrations in the proposed architecture/ADR and per-PR packets. Author and approve matching area-spec amendments on implementation branches; current main specs must not assert unshipped behavior. Bind any formal execution handoff to raw approved spec hashes.

Inspect every shared-interface implementer named in V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md before passing the design boundary. Unresolved choices pause only dependent architectural tasks; do not mark this portfolio plan as a fully gated Smith handoff.
tasks.commit_message: docs(architecture): settle scoped release ownership contracts

tasks.title: Canonicalize new references through one owner-aware resolver
steps: Baseline: status and version both resolve changeset selectors through IdentityIndex.resolve_id; new identifiers still depend on sibling collisions.

Implement D01's canonical-reference/migration contract at one shared owner-aware resolver, including native name normalization and actionable legacy ambiguity errors. Emit canonical exact references for add/init/reports/groups/config without conflating different outputs with release owners.

Migrate all selector consumers, both status helpers, package/group rules, changesets, pre-state and CLI selection together. Keep glob matching as an explicitly separate pattern language, not an exact-ID parser.
Align GroupTable::from_groups conflict validation with resolve so no alternate construction path silently bypasses the group invariant; add the sibling constructor regression in config/group tests.

Add paired status/version/matrix/release-selector tests for non-primary native names, unrelated ecosystem-qualified names, scoped npm names, normalized Python names, duplicate native distribution IDs, rejected new bare/colon aliases, migrated historical records and deterministic report ordering. Cover product-package and artifact package selectors alongside groups, package rules and changesets; retain glob patterns as a separate language.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model, rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test identity_promotion_tests plus --test status_check_tests sequentially. Update current specs and migration docs with the behavior; retain historical tag readers for T06-HISTORY.

tasks.title: Resolve historic ownership from full native manifest evidence
steps: Baseline: bare-tag ownership falls back to the manifest roster at the tag's commit and a demoted package keeps its qualified tags; a changed native name or an explicit rename still has no boundary.

Share historical ownership resolution between tag selection and pre-state attribution using historical native names and the full admitted manifest roster at the relevant commit. Preserve a source owner's correct bare and qualified history after sibling addition/removal or primary-manifest changes.

Apply D01's explicit rename/move support boundary; refuse uncertain transfer with an actionable error rather than assigning another owner's tag. Do not rename existing tags or require an opaque identity ledger.

Test promotion/demotion, sibling rename, Cargo manifest added to an npm-first directory, changed native names, ambiguous old records, conflicting legacy and canonical pre-state keys, old prerelease keys and custom templates; verify last-release monotonicity and no cross-owner adoption without silently discarding a baseline.

Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test identity_promotion_tests sequentially. Preserve lazy/cached Git discovery and update docs/specs/ADR status only with the implementation.
tasks.commit_message: fix(identity): preserve owned historical release records

tasks.title: Deduplicate shared physical effects and enforce publication barriers
steps: Finding coverage: none open. Shipped: the owner publication barrier (a package tag waits for the registry publishes of every release identity it has) and one tag, forge release and forge publish per owner. Remaining: package dependencies order all owner outputs, and any wire versioning D01 requires.

Implement D01's single-owner physical effects and deterministic operation IDs; one tag/draft/upload/publication may be referenced by several distributions but executed once. Reject contradictory tag target/destination/owner declarations before any effect.

Project native dependency publication prerequisites from the relevant manifest/distribution, not every output of the source node. Gate current supported registry ecosystems' shared tag/publication on all required selected native publishes; retain platform-before-owner and artifact-before-publication prerequisites.

Migrate intent validation/digests, preparation, production ValidatedReleaseIntent, SimWorld, provider dispatch, receipt evidence and schema guard tests as one compilation boundary. Do not add a scheduler or persisted execution state.
Retain redacted native stderr for indeterminate failures. Fix a lost safe diagnostic in this batch; explicitly track a sibling outside the owned boundary.

Add dual Cargo/npm permutations, failure of either registry, shared product assets, selected/unselected native dependencies, dev/non-dev cycles and duplicate/conflicting effects. Run rtk cargo test -p callisto-model, rtk cargo test -p callisto-graph and rtk cargo test -p callisto-cli --test durable_release_e2e_tests sequentially.

Verify deterministic DAG order and no public announcement before required publications; check Go's hypothetical tag-as-publication scenario without a Go provider. Version the wire if D01 changes identity/proof shape and keep old-reader policy explicit.
tasks.commit_message: fix(release): complete shared effects across retries

tasks.title: Verify production native workflows and boundary recovery
steps: Run the fixture/evidence matrix in V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md with actual native packing/building and representative clean consumer installs. Retain existing local npm/Cargo/PyPI tests and distinguish argv-only, production-provider, simulator and hosted coverage.

Exercise production registry binding/readback for local Cargo/PyPI servers and the Python file-set fixtures (pypi_file_set_tests); record each prerequisite skip explicitly. Deterministic faults must cover every changed apply/effect boundary, with missing work converging using original inputs.

Run rtk proxy just ci, plus the relevant shell/workflow policy/contract suites not actually included by just ci. Consider live provider-contract/fixture refresh only with network authority; never recapture fixtures or upload a version as an incidental test.

Record source/branch revisions, exact commands, prerequisite versions, pass/fail/skip counts and remaining findings in V1-VERIFICATION.md. A named test or passing simulator does not establish production coverage.
Correct the receipt run_attempt comment and policy-test message to match attempt-scoped artifact names; do not add an approval gate or change the release workflow's authorization.

Reconcile shipped specs/docs and findings as each PR lands; delete completed implementation plans only after all work they cover ships, retaining owner decisions and measured evidence in the appropriate durable docs.
tasks.commit_message: test(release): exercise native publication and recovery workflows

tasks.title: Measure supported first-release onboarding
steps: Create isolated fresh Cargo, npm/pnpm and supported Python repos and follow documented init/add/commit/version/commit/release steps. Record prerequisites, credential/commit setup and failures, not only successful CLI command duration.

Measure against the owner's existing under-ten-minute goal using local registry targets for repeatability and a separately authorized hosted self-release/publication for real service evidence. Do not claim local tests prove hosted credential/index behavior.

Verify representative package installation, npm native addon load, Python wheel metadata/import and Cargo locked resolution. Maturin local/native support and unsupported generated CI must remain distinguishable.

Use measured failures to improve only in-scope onboarding/docs; report blocker requiring owner choice instead of hiding setup time or publishing without approval. Run documentation/link checks and relevant CLI regressions after doc/example changes.

Close the v1 evidence review only when applicable owner requirements are demonstrated, or report the exact unmet requirement. No arbitrary Go/NuGet gate, new hosted publication or support promise is authorized by this task.

reasoning: Execution portfolio authorized for planning on 2026-09-26; baseline main 8ef9aa5a4, since shipped through 0.10.2; only the unshipped tasks remain. See docs/projects/V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md for governing-source hashes, PR lanes, concurrency/file-ownership constraints, plugin/model routing, decision checkpoints and explicit roadmap dispositions. Coverage gap: this spans five current-behavior specs and proposed future architecture; there is no single approved persisted delta spec. linked_spec/spec_file_path/spec_hash are intentionally absent rather than inventing a gated Smith handoff. covers_criteria identifies affected current contracts; testable per-PR behavior and any spec amendments must be approved and hash-bound before executing gated architectural packets. Current-contract repair packets may start independently after baseline verification and implementation authorization. D01 blocks only new identity/authority/effect/file-set policy, not existing bugs. No remote PR creation, commits, pushes, branch/worktree creation or publication is authorized by this plan alone. Existing roadmap decisions not implemented here remain explicitly open, not implicit v1 gates.
